lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-intensity circular nodes in a matrix-like grid posterior to the pectoral fin; nodes are organized into approximately 6 vertical columns with 4-5 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity run dorso-ventrally, intersecting with horizontal rows of spots to form a recurring grid pattern where each spot serves as a central node within the band.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal elevations visible along the flank; the primary ridge displays a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal surface to a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density arrangement of small, high-luminance circular clusters scattered across the visible surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct high-contrast aquatic organisms in close proximity to the ventral-lateral boundary and pectoral fin.
